scope: Read-only public OpenRouter routing, price and reasoning diagnosis; no credential request, source change, account change or runtime admission by this worker.

selection.query: Join ZDR endpoints.model_id to default models.id; require text input/output, :free suffix, and numeric prompt and completion prices both zero in both records.
limits: A public endpoint listing does not prove eligibility under a particular key, guardrail, quota or current provider capacity.
Other audio, image and reranking endpoints have zero prompt/completion prices; some charge other price dimensions. They are outside this text-advisory query.
The free variants of Gemma 4 31B, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and Inkling occur in the default model catalog but not in the observed ZDR endpoint list.

official_semantics.finding: provider.max_price supports prompt/completion caps in USD per million tokens and request for per-request pricing. Preserve all zero caps; the docs do not establish that an absent request price causes exclusion.
Account, guardrail and request ZDR combine by OR. A request cannot disable higher-level ZDR. Endpoint-specific policy can differ from provider defaults.

Reasoning tokens consume output budget. reasoning.exclude=true only omits reasoning from the response; it does not disable computation. Model metadata identifies mandatory reasoning and default enablement. Dynamic routers omit this metadata.

peer_counterevidence.source: Root agent message during this task; not independently credential-probed by this worker
peer_counterevidence.request: openrouter/free, max_tokens128, all provider.max_price values zero, account settings unchanged by this session
peer_counterevidence.reported_observation: HTTP200, selected inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-fin:free via Novita, reported cost0, finish_reason length, content null with reasoning token exhaustion
peer_counterevidence.inference: This successful routing falsifies universal exclusion by max_price.request=0. It is not a usable advisory completion.

jidoka_classes.action: Hold; retain exact root-owned error evidence; do not infer a permanent or account-global outage.

jidoka_classes.trigger: HTTP200, null/empty final content and finish_reason length
jidoka_classes.action: Reject as unusable; do not substitute reasoning text for a final answer.

jidoka_classes.trigger: Nonempty final content, consistent usage within512, explicit reported cost0 and existing policy gates pass
jidoka_classes.action: May record bounded advisory success; no side-effect authority or system admission follows.

remediation_candidate.activation: Root must verify a bounded zero-cost response through the strict adapter before resuming advisory use. Explicit Fin selection requires a reviewed exact-model allowlist update. No privacy or guardrail relaxation is proposed.
